pkgmetadata.longdescription: Winc is a lightweight desktop code editor written in Rust. It provides multi-cursor editing, find and replace, syntax highlighting, side-by-side diffs, an integrated terminal, and previews for Markdown, images, SVG, PDF, Word documents, and spreadsheets.
Winc 是一款使用 Rust 编写的轻量级桌面代码编辑器，支持多光标编辑、查找替换、 语法高亮、并排差异对比、内置终端，以及 Markdown、图片、SVG、PDF、Word 文档和电子表格预览。
